goal: Polish the existing project landing: concise Vietnamese copy, three agreed experiments, truthful previews and calmer responsive design. Implement docs/ui/landing-page-audit.md.
accept: Follow the audit copy deck and ownership limits: home copy only, layout footer/description only, landing/footer CSS only. Keep chapter order, existing Vietnamese font and light/dark identity.

Show pH, Jar Test and batch methylene-blue adsorption from one landing metadata source. pH links to the existing acid route and is labeled current; the other two are in development with no fabricated Start route.

Preview labels remain visible; adding/resetting demonstrates only supported local presentation, never invents measurements, scoring, API calls or stored attempts. Remove obsolete copper/plastic marketing, Ksp, fixed source counts and repeated acid-only homepage disclosures.

Improve hierarchy, mobile preview density and restrained motion; preserve keyboard/focus/menu, reduced motion, readable 200% zoom and no horizontal overflow at 390/768/1440px. Local verifies browser evidence if unavailable on web.

Work only on the assigned branch from the pinned base; read the required source first. Stop after one implementation handback using result JSON v1 with coder/branch, actual head and all check IDs. No next task, merge or deployment.
